classification.difficultyReason: Read the vertical-axis label and apply the taught dependent-variable convention; no calculation or inference from the regression equation is needed.

content.prompt:
A café records the maximum daily temperature and the number of hot drinks sold. The scatterplot and its regression equation are shown.

What is the dependent variable?

spec.description: Maximum daily temperature against number of hot drinks sold. Ten observations chosen for this item; observations and fitted line use house black.
spec.answerVisibility: The graph, observations, axis labels and regression equation are permanent student givens.

answer.worked: Number of hot drinks sold is the dependent variable, shown on the vertical axis.
